theater: 安納托利亞至尼羅河三角洲

battle.name: 青銅時期晩期崩潰
battle.theater: 安納托利亞至尼羅河三角洲
battle.brief: 公元前1206年前後，安納托利亞的赫梯帝國、愛琴海的邁錫尼宮殿體系同黎凡特的城邦王國相繼崩解，銅錫商路與文字傳承一併中斷。埃及是唯一沒被打垮的大國，月牙劍配在步兵與僱傭兵手上，隨駐軍守住尼羅河到迦南的驛道，在三角洲擋下向埃及推進的聯盟軍，成為崩塌期裡唯一延續的國家軍事體系。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 青銅時代晚期的崩塌不是兩軍對壘的一場戰役，而是一整條崩解的連鎖，因此交戰方必須分層來看。第一層是正在解體的一方：安納托利亞中部的赫梯帝國，靠國王的直屬軍團、盟邦的徵召兵同安納托利亞南部的游騎維持局面；愛琴海一邊是邁錫尼的宮殿體系，國王（瓦納克斯）以書吏、泥板同役畜帳冊調度軍隊；黎凡特海岸的城邦王國，如烏加里特、阿拉拉赫、美吉多，靠王宮警衛、僱傭步兵同雙輪輕戰車維持秩序。第二層是壓過來的攻勢：從海上同陸地同時進入的聯盟軍，埃及碑銘把其中幾支部族記作舍爾登、謝克萊什、提克爾、佩萊塞特、德嫩；安納托利亞南部出現過被赫梯文獻稱為卡爾比德的劫掠者；還有以哈比魯之名活動於邊境與城郊的武裝團體，成員常是被解僱的僱傭兵同邊民。第三層是唯一沒有崩掉的埃及：其軍制是職業常備軍，步兵以長矛列陣，弓手在兩翼，王室戰車隊居中衝鋒，並且僱用舍爾登人等外族兵充當近衛。崩塌之所以發生，正因為三方在同一條補給線上互相消耗，而且沒有一方強到可以一次把另一方推平。
countriesEn: The collapse of the Late Bronze Age was not a battle between two armies but a whole chain of disintegration, so the belligerents have to be read in layers. The first layer is the side that was coming apart: the Hittite empire of central Anatolia, which held together with the king's own troops, the levies of the vassal states and the raiders of southern Anatolia; on the Aegean side the Mycenaean palatial system, whose wanax directed an army through scribes, clay tablets and registers of draught animals; and the city-state kingdoms of the Levantine coast such as Ugarit, Alalakh and Megiddo, which kept their order with palace guards, mercenary infantry and light two-wheeled chariots. The second layer is the pressure that came over them: a coalition arriving by sea and by land at the same time, of which Egyptian monuments record several contingents under the names Sherden, Shekelesh, Tjekker, Peleset and Denyen; the raiders of southern Anatolia called the Kalbid in the Hittite texts; and armed bands working the frontier and the ground outside the cities under the name Habiru, often made up of dismissed mercenaries and border dwellers. The third layer is Egypt, the one power that did not collapse. Its system was a professional standing army: infantry drawn up with spears, archers on the flanks, the royal chariot corps in the middle, and foreign soldiers such as the Sherden taken on as bodyguard. The collapse came about precisely because all three parties drew on the same lines of supply and wore each other down, and because none of them was strong enough to knock the others flat in a single stroke.
people: 可以點名的人物多集中在崩塌的兩端。埃及一端是拉美西斯二世之子麥內普塔，他的卡納克碑文在公元前1208年前後第一次把提克爾、佩萊塞特、謝克萊什連同利布人記在同一份名單裡；同一塊石碑的另一面還留下以色列這個名號，是該名號最早的域外文字記錄。再往後是拉美西斯三世，他於公元前十二世紀末在尼羅河三角洲迎擊同一批聯盟軍，把戰役刻在梅迪奈特哈布的王陵浮雕上，並在哈里斯紙草卷裡按部族清點戰果。埃及的國家機器此時已裂成兩半：底比斯的赫里霍爾以大神父身分自立為王，尼羅河三角洲的軍人推舉尼蘇巴內布傑三世，大王只剩虛名。安納托利亞一端是赫梯末代幾位國王：穆瓦塔里二世重整中央軍，圖德哈里亞四世在崩塌前數十年就試圖用阿爾坎提亞瓦之戰壓住西部邊患，最後一位可考的赫梯君主穆爾西里三世在自己的都城被攻破時下落不明。愛琴海一端只剩宮殿檔案：皮洛斯泥板上的收成登記、信給涅斯特的文書同那枚皮洛斯戰鬥縞瑪瑙把戰爭的樣子留下，卻沒有留下任何一位指揮者的名字。攻方的領袖更是無名，碑文只記部族不記人。
peopleEn: The figures who can be named cluster at the two ends of the collapse. On the Egyptian side there is Merneptah, son of Ramesses II, whose Karnak inscription of about 1208 BC records for the first time the names of the Tjekker, Peleset and Shekelesh together with the Libu; the other face of the same stele also carries the name of Israel, the earliest written mention of that name outside the Bible. After him comes Ramesses III, who met the same coalition at the Nile Delta towards the end of the twelfth century BC, cut the battle into the reliefs of his mortuary temple at Medinet Habu, and set out the results of the campaign tribe by tribe in the Papyrus Harris. The Egyptian state machine had by then split in two: at Thebes Herihor ruled as high priest in his own right, in the Delta the soldiers of the army had raised Nesbanebdjed III, and the Great King was a name without power. On the Anatolian side stand the last Hittite kings. Muwatalli II reorganised the central army; Tudhaliya IV had already tried, decades before the collapse, to hold down the trouble in the west with the war against Ahhiyawa; and the last Hittite ruler whose existence can be checked, Mursili III, disappears from the record at the moment his own capital is broken open. On the Aegean side only the palace archives survive: the harvest registers of Pylos, the letter to Nestor and the Pylos Combat Agate preserve the look of the fighting, yet not a single commander's name. The leaders of the attackers are nameless altogether, for the inscriptions record tribes and not men.
kits: 卡面上的埃及月牙劍，是埃及人從早王朝的彎首短刀一路改下來的單刃青銅劍：外彎的刃在砍劈時不易卡在骨頭或盾面，收刀不需拔拉，因此被列進近戰兵器的常備配給。到新王國時期，它是埃及步兵手中最典型的一件近身兵器，長度不及小臂，握把與護手一體成形，劍脊厚重。這件兵器在崩塌期裡的位置很特別，它是唯一沒有隨著宮殿體系一起消失的近戰刀型。埃及的常備軍與其僱傭兵守著從尼羅河到迦南的驛道與要塞，線形文字B同烏加里特泥板記錄的物資流，也把埃及的兵器樣式帶到黎凡特；與此同時，月牙劍的近親——新月形的直身劍——在十三至十二世紀由安納托利亞同黎凡特傳開，崩潰層出土的這類銅劍說明攻守雙方其實用著同一族刀型的不同變體。愛琴海一邊的裝備在崩塌前夜反而是當時技術最高的：德德拉全套青銅鎧，包括胸甲、護肩、脛甲同頭盔，配八角形大盾、青銅矛、帶鑄尾的長矛、箭鏃同投石索，另有兩匹馬拉的雙輪戰車。赫梯方面是複合弓、短劍、青銅斧，以及數量極少卻最早的鐵器，即隕鐵製的小件。海上的部分由雙列划槳的長船同帶操舵槳的戰船構成，埃及在尼羅河口以海軍迎擊聯盟軍的船隊，梅迪奈特哈布的浮雕把船形、划槳手同船上的戰士都刻了出來。攻城器械在崩塌期留下的痕跡極少，烏加里特同美吉多的毀滅層顯示的是縱火而不是撞槌，說明攻方志在破壞產能而不是久攻城池。
kitsEn: The Egyptian khopesh on the card is a single-edged bronze sword that the Egyptians developed out of the curved knives of the Early Dynastic period: the outward curve of the blade makes it hard to catch on bone or on the face of a shield, and it can be drawn back without a twist, so it was carried as standard issue among close-combat troops. By the New Kingdom it was the most characteristic close weapon in the hands of Egyptian infantry, less than a forearm long, with grip and pommel formed in one piece and a heavy spine. Its position during the collapse is peculiar, for it was the only close-bladed weapon that did not disappear together with the palatial systems. Egypt's standing army and its mercenaries held the roads and forts between the Nile and Canaan, and the flows of goods recorded in Linear B and in the Ugaritic tablets carried Egyptian weapon patterns into the Levant; at the same time the near relative of the khopesh, the straight crescent or lunate sword, spread through Anatolia and the Levant in the thirteenth and twelfth centuries, and the copper blades of that type found in the destruction layers show that attacker and defender were using different variants of one family of blades. On the Aegean side the equipment of the eve of the collapse was in fact the most advanced in the region: the full bronze Dendra panoply of cuirass, pauldrons, greaves and helmet, the eight-shaped or tower shield, bronze spears, spears with a cast butt, arrowheads and slings, together with a light chariot drawn by two horses. The Hittite side had composite bows, short swords, bronze axes and the earliest iron, that is the very rare objects made of meteoric iron. The maritime part consisted of long vessels propelled by two rows of oars and of warships with steering oars; Egypt met the coalition fleet at the mouth of the Nile, and the reliefs of Medinet Habu record the shape of the hulls, the oarsmen and the warriors on board. Almost no trace of siege engines survives from this period, and the destruction layers of Ugarit and Megiddo show arson rather than the ram, which means the attackers meant to break the productive capacity of a city rather than to hold it.
tactics: 崩塌期的戰術沒有單一範式，卻有共同的骨架：短促、同時、多方向的打擊，配合對補給與行政的破壞。安納托利亞南部的游騎同海上的船隊沿海岸線推進，在收割季節前後切入城邦的外圍，奪港、燒倉、破橋，然後在援軍到達之前撤回海路或山區。烏加里特書信裡有求援者描述海上來的人同哈比魯的劫掠，也提到葡萄園與果園被燒的損失，這類文字說明敵人針對的是稅基與存糧，而不是攻城拔寨的榮譽。城邦的守軍靠城牆、王宮警衛同僱傭步兵分段抵抗，缺銅、缺糧、缺文書傳令的城市在兩三次襲擊之後就再也組織不起有效的反擊。愛琴海一端的軍隊編制可以從皮洛斯的線形文字B泥板讀出：其中一類條目按三十至四十人的划槳人編組登記入冊，說明宮廷的戰爭機器連船隊的槳手都能逐點調度；另一枚皮洛斯戰鬥縞瑪瑙刻出近身格鬥的樣子，持八角盾的守方同持矛的進攻者貼在一起，畫面裡沒有戰車，反映邁錫尼世界在崩塌前夕正由車戰轉向步兵。埃及的戰術最完整：拉美西斯三世的三角洲之戰裡，聯盟軍先以步兵同弓手接戰，埃及以王族戰車隊自側翼反衝，弓手在後列掩護，海軍則在近岸攔截敵船。赫梯方面的戰術在崩塌前已被戰爭拖垮，末期文書記載國王不得不下令解除部分盟邦的兵役，理由正是饑荒與疫病。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the collapse had no single pattern, but they shared a skeleton: short, simultaneous, multi-directional blows combined with the destruction of supplies and administration. The horsemen of southern Anatolia and the fleets worked along the coast, striking at the outer districts of the city-states before and after the harvest, taking the harbour, burning the granaries, breaking the bridges, and then withdrawing by sea or into the hills before help could arrive. The letters of Ugarit describe attackers coming from the sea and the Habiru raiding, and record the loss of vineyards and orchards; texts of this kind show that the enemy was aiming at the tax base and the stored grain rather than at the honour of taking a city by storm. The defenders held out in sections behind walls, with palace guards and mercenary infantry, and a city short of copper, short of food and short of written orders could no longer organise an effective counter-stroke after two or three raids. On the Aegean side the military system can be read from the Linear B tablets of Pylos: one class of entry lists crews of thirty to forty rowers, which shows that the palace could muster the oarsmen of a fleet point by point; the Pylos Combat Agate in turn cuts out close combat, a defender with an eight-shaped shield pressed against an attacker with a spear, with no chariot in the scene, reflecting the shift in the Mycenaean world from fighting by chariot to fighting on foot. The Egyptian tactics are the most complete. In the Delta battle of Ramesses III the coalition engaged with infantry and archers, Egypt answered with a charge of the royal chariot corps from the flank, archers covered the rear and the fleet intercepted the enemy ships close inshore. The Hittite tactics had already been ruined by war before the collapse: late documents record the king releasing the service obligations of some vassal states precisely because of famine and disease.
data: 可核對的數字分四類。第一類是年表：中文的戰爭列表把崩塌繫於公元前1206年；考古同文本給出的區間是公元前1200年至前1150年，烏加里特的毀滅層多定於前1190年，最後一批可辨的赫梯文書落在前1170年代，線形文字B的最後一批泥板則在前十一世紀末。前1208年麥內普塔的卡納克碑文是海上民族名號最早的成組記錄；拉美西斯三世梅迪奈特哈布的浮雕屬於前1180年代，哈里斯紙草卷一按部族列出戰果，浮雕上可辨的俘虜形象約八百上下，紙草卷所記的赫梯與西沙俘虜總數以千計，雙方損失的具體人數沒有任何一份文獻可以核實。第二類是地理尺度：崩塌帶沿安納托利亞、安納托利亞東岸、黎凡特直到埃及北部，連續海岸線逾一千五百公里，宮殿城市與王國數十個，一說被毀或被棄的城邑超過三百座。第三類是產能與物資：阿瑪爾納書信顯示，阿拉西亞也就是塞浦路斯在數十年間向埃及輸送以百噸計的銅，阿拉西亞王寫給埃及的信件裡常用銅字作為問候語；赫梯的壟斷讓安納托利亞的青銅供應得以穩定，崩塌之後銅與錫的長途路線斷裂，地中海東岸的青銅器產量隨之跌落。第四類是軍制與人數：埃及的常備軍在拉美西斯二世時已有數萬之眾的估計，邁錫尼與赫梯的兵員只能從泥板同徵召簿推算，沒有可靠總數，任何守軍三千、來犯五萬一類的說法都應打折扣。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked fall into four classes. The first is chronology. The Chinese list of battles ties the collapse to 1206 BC; the interval given by archaeology and by the texts runs from about 1200 to 1150 BC, the destruction layer of Ugarit is usually placed at 1190 BC, the last legible Hittite documents fall in the 1170s BC, and the last batch of Linear B tablets dates to the end of the eleventh century BC. The Karnak inscription of Merneptah of 1208 BC is the earliest grouped record of the names of the Sea Peoples; the reliefs of Medinet Habu belong to the 1180s BC, and the Papyrus Harris lists the results of the campaign tribe by tribe. Roughly eight hundred captive figures can be made out on the reliefs, and the number of Hittite and Shasu prisoners given in the papyrus runs into the thousands, while no document allows the actual losses on either side to be verified. The second class is geographic scale. The zone of collapse ran along Anatolia, the Anatolian coast, the Levant and northern Egypt, a continuous coastline of more than fifteen hundred kilometres, with dozens of palatial cities and kingdoms; one reckoning puts the number of cities destroyed or abandoned at more than three hundred. The third class is capacity and materials. The Amarna letters show that Alashiya, that is Cyprus, shipped Egypt copper by the hundred tonnes over a number of decades, and the king of Alashiya used the word copper itself as a greeting in his letters to Egypt; Hittite control was what kept the bronze supply of Anatolia stable, and when that control went the long-distance routes for copper and tin were cut and the output of bronze objects in the eastern Mediterranean fell with them. The fourth class is order of battle and numbers. The Egyptian standing army in the reign of Ramesses II is estimated in the tens of thousands, while the strength of the Mycenaean and Hittite forces can only be inferred from tablets and muster lists, with no reliable total, and any statement of three thousand defenders against fifty thousand attackers should be taken with a heavy discount.
cause: 崩塌的原因是多因並發，沒有任何一條足以單獨解釋。第一層是系統性的依賴：這些宮殿經濟靠遠距供應維持，錫來自東方山區，銅來自塞浦路斯，金、象牙同藍石來自更遠的地方，穀物與橄欖油靠海運周轉；任何一條線中斷，依賴它的那一段就開始崩解，而崩解會順著依賴網迅速擴散。第二層是氣候：二〇一〇年提出的三百年乾冷期模型，把前1500年至前1200年視為東地中海持續偏冷偏乾的區段，隨後以死海沉積物化學訊號重建出的氣候序列，更指出前十二世紀初確有長達數十年、上百年的乾旱，農產下降會同時削弱城市的存糧與徵兵能力。第三層是自然災害的連擊：一般定於前1177年的地震在克里特同塞浦路斯留下痕跡，開羅紙草記錄了那次地震，而更早的火山爆發，一般定於前1600年前後，時間太早，無法為這場崩塌負責。第四層是內部的政治崩解：赫梯在瘟疫與王位繼承危機後靠聯盟維持；埃及在拉美西斯二世之後出現底比斯與三角洲的雙重王權，軍隊與僱傭兵開始各自為政；安納托利亞南部的卡爾比德與愛琴海一線的劫掠者長期侵擾邊境。最後還有人的因素：這些軍隊並非一支外來大軍，而是同一批僱傭兵與邊民在各國體制崩解之後各自覓食，海上民族很可能就是多支部族在同一條戰線上先後湧入的結果。
causeEn: The causes of the collapse are multiple and concurrent, and no single one of them explains it. The first layer is systemic dependence. These palatial economies rested on long-distance supply: tin from the mountains to the east, copper from Cyprus, gold, ivory and lapis from further afield, with grain and olive oil moving by sea. When any one of those lines was cut, the section that depended on it began to come apart, and the disintegration spread quickly along the network of dependence. The second layer is climate. The three-century cold and dry phase proposed in 2010 treats the period from 1500 to 1200 BC as one of persistent cold and dryness in the eastern Mediterranean, and the climate sequence reconstructed afterwards from the chemical signals in Dead Sea sediments points to a drought of decades, even of more than a century, at the start of the twelfth century BC, when a fall in agricultural output would weaken both the stored grain and the recruiting base of the cities. The third layer is a run of natural disasters: an earthquake generally dated to 1177 BC left traces in Crete and Cyprus and is recorded in a papyrus from Cairo, whereas the earlier volcanic eruption, generally placed around 1600 BC, is too early to be held responsible for this collapse. The fourth layer is internal political breakdown. Hatti had held together by alliance after the plague and the succession crisis; after Ramesses II, Egypt showed a dual kingship of Thebes and the Delta, and the army and its mercenaries began to act on their own account; the Kalbid of southern Anatolia and the raiders of the Aegean line had harried the frontiers for years. Last of all there is the human factor. These were not a single invading army, but the same mercenaries and border men going in search of a living once the states that employed them had collapsed, which is why the Sea Peoples are best understood not as one people but as several groups arriving in succession along the same line of war.
impact: 崩塌的後果不是毀滅，而是不再重建。邁錫尼的宮殿制度、書寫傳統同車戰在希臘本土退場，線形文字B從此沒有新的使用者，希臘進入以村落為單位的黑暗時期，隨後在公元前十二至十一世紀由另一批集團重建城鎮；部分邁錫尼居民東渡塞浦路斯與義大利南部的薩普、蓬塔德爾薩科，多數研究認為西西里與義大利出土的所謂邁錫尼式器物，正與這批移民有關。黎凡特方面，海上民族中的佩萊塞特一支在迦南南部落地建城，後來的五城聯盟，迦薩、亞實基倫、亞述、基倫、迦特，由此成形；字母文字也在同樣被打斷的黎凡特沿海傳出，成為腓尼基字母的源頭。安納托利亞的中央權威消失後，赫梯的舊地由數個新赫梯王國瓜分，安納托利亞高原的族群大約在此時進入；埃及沒有崩潰，但付出代價：它失去迦南與安納托利亞的緩衝，進入第二中間期，二十一王朝在三角洲重新集結軍力，最終把主動權握回手中。技術上，鐵由新奇的嘗試變成可用之物，戰車在愛琴海退場，步兵配長矛的組合成為常態；月牙劍本身在埃及也走向退場，被直身短劍與斧取代，留下的只是一種已經用了一千五百年的刀型在混亂中的最後一次大規模部署。
impactEn: The consequence of the collapse was not destruction but the failure to rebuild. The Mycenaean palatial system, its written tradition and its chariot warfare disappeared from the Greek mainland, Linear B found no new speakers, and Greece entered a dark age of village-sized communities, later reorganised by other groups between the twelfth and eleventh centuries BC; some Mycenaean refugees moved east to Cyprus and to Thapsos and Punta del Sacco in southern Italy, and most scholars connect the so-called Mycenaean-style objects found in Sicily and Italy with these migrants. In the Levant the Peleset, one of the Sea Peoples, settled in the south of Canaan and built cities, and the later league of five cities, Gaza, Ashkelon, Ashdod, Ekron and Gath, took shape from this; alphabetical writing also spread out of the same disrupted Levantine coast and became the source of the Phoenician script. With central authority gone from Anatolia, the old Hittite lands were divided among several Neo-Hittite states, and the Anatolian highland peoples entered the region at about this time. Egypt did not collapse, but it paid for its survival: it lost the buffer of Canaan and Anatolia, entered the Second Intermediate Period, and the Twenty-first Dynasty re-gathered military power in the Delta until it could take the initiative again. Technologically, iron moved from novelty to usable material, the chariot retreated from the Aegean, and the combination of infantry and spear became the norm; the khopesh itself went out of use in Egypt, replaced by the straight short sword and the axe, and what remained was the last large-scale deployment, in disorder, of a blade type that had already been in use for fifteen hundred years.
result: 到公元前1150年前後，東地中海的宮殿體系整體退場：赫梯帝國崩解，邁錫尼宮殿燒毀，黎凡特與塞浦路斯的多數城市變成廢墟或改作他用，行政、稅收、文字與冶金作坊同時中斷，這就是青銅時代末期崩塌在考古學上留下的判準。埃及是唯一的例外，它靠尼羅河的餘糧、常備軍與僱傭兵守住國土，卻也因此被拖入持久的邊境戰：拉美西斯三世之後是漫長的第二中間期，直到公元前十一世紀中葉才重新取得對黎凡特的優勢。結果的另一面是新的格局成形：腓尼基城邦、迦南的以色列與非利士人王國、新赫梯諸國同亞述在廢墟上重建秩序，字母、鐵器與步兵戰術成為下一階段的技術前提，愛琴海則要到公元前八世紀才重新出現成形的國家。就兵器而言，崩塌期是月牙劍的尾聲而非高峰：埃及仍以它守住尼羅河三角洲，卻在拉美西斯王朝結束後把它改為榮譽性的象徵，實戰交給直劍與斧；海峽兩岸那些仿製的新月形刀型則隨移民與征戰擴散，成為西元前一千年以後西利劍與鐵劍的造型先驅。
resultEn: By about 1150 BC the palatial system of the eastern Mediterranean had withdrawn altogether: the Hittite empire had broken up, the Mycenaean palaces were burnt, and most of the cities of the Levant and Cyprus lay in ruins or were put to other uses, while administration, taxation, writing and the metal workshops all were interrupted at once, and that is the criterion by which archaeologists identify the Late Bronze Age collapse. Egypt was the exception, holding its territory on the surplus of the Nile, a standing army and mercenaries, but it was in consequence dragged into a long border war: after Ramesses III came the long Second Intermediate Period, and only in the middle of the eleventh century BC did Egypt recover the upper hand in the Levant. The other face of the outcome is a new pattern taking shape: the Phoenician city-states, the Israelite and Philistine kingdoms of Canaan, the Neo-Hittite states and Assyria rebuilt order on the ruins, while the alphabet, iron and infantry tactics became the technical premises of the next age, and the Aegean did not see a formed state again until the eighth century BC. As for weapons, the collapse was the coda of the khopesh rather than its high point. Egypt still used it to hold the Nile Delta, but after the end of the Ramesside dynasty it became an honorary emblem, and actual fighting passed to straight swords and axes; the imitations of the crescent blade spread with migration and war on both sides of the straits and became the stylistic ancestor of the falcata and the iron sword of the first millennium BC.
